served_context_note: integer for check_context_contract.py: the engine admits a state of at most 8192 tokens plus a question of at most 2048 tokens per row; the longest row validated against the HF reference is 2300 tokens (current_supported_context below)

current_supported_context.note: stage 3: engine default max_state_len 65536 (kev's serving limit), question row up to 2048 tokens after the 128-aligned state prefix; validated with test_long_state (S 16384 tail equals full row, S 65536 no-crash) and the reference rows

capability_reduction: none for the state (65536 served); a question row is limited to 2048 tokens plus the state remainder under 128, below kev's 73728-token row budget
limiting_reason: question tails run as one fixed bucket of at most 2048 tokens (the largest warmed trace); longer rows would need a chunked tail path

row_form.description: one plain causal row per question: [<|fim_prefix|> state] [<|fim_middle|> instr (<|box_start|> option <|box_end|>)* <|fim_suffix|>], positions 0..L-1, no cross-question attention

functional.hardware: one Blackhole P150 chip (device 0), traced engine since stage 3
functional.weight_precision: stage 4 selected config mlp_bfp8 (doc/datatype_sweep/selected_precision_config.json): MLP gate/up bfp8, MLP down / attention / GDN projections bfp8, LoFi with fp32 accumulation, KV cache bf16, GDN state bf16; applied by tt/precision_defaults.py (KEV_PRECISION=baseline restores bfp4 gate/up); merged LoRA cache tensor_cache_bfp8_kev_2b2a70cf_gu-bfp8_dn-bfp8_pj-bfp8 (10.47 GB, 1.6 GB more than the baseline cache)

base_weights_control.weights: base (Qwen36ModelArgs) through the same device path and pointer head

served_request.path: HTTP server, prefix pass plus GDN snapshot plus one tail per question

watcher.cases: tests/test_engine.py::test_hidden_vs_hf[{300,2300}-l4] with TT_METAL_WATCHER=10, base weights, prefill_hidden only

not_validated: rows above 2300 tokens (three or more 2048-token segments)
prefill_state / question_hidden or merged weights under the watcher
two states interleaved across snapshot slots (review P1: slots share one KV cache)

persistent_allocations_stage3.kv_slots: min(requested, (free DRAM - 3 GiB) // per-slot bytes); 8 at 65536 on a P150 (21.26 GiB free after weights)
persistent_allocations_stage3.traces: fwd and gather per bucket {128,256,512,1024,2048}, restore and save per slot, zero (27 traces at 8 slots)
persistent_allocations_stage3.weight_dtypes: unchanged from stage 1 (bfp4 MLP gate/up, bfp8 elsewhere, bf16 norms and embedding)

dram_free_after_weights_gib.note: max_state_len 8192 build; at 65536 the traced probe reports 19.76 GiB free and 8 of 8 slots fit (perf_probe_mlp_bfp8.json)

stage4_precision.context_effect: none: the selected config does not change the KV-cache dtype, trace buffers, or chunking; 8 snapshot slots at max_state_len 65536 still fit
stage4_precision.matmul_policy: KEV_MATMUL_POLICY defaults to 0 under the selected config because the stage 3 MATMUL_POLICY 2D program configs overflow L1 with bfp8 gate/up weights (doc/datatype_sweep/README.md)
